message: 公団住宅の隅で

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haaah... Special training and Student Council work even on our days off... I'm completely beat!」

name: Sally
message: 「Me tooo~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You didn't do any Student Council work, though!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're also preparing the Sweets Club's exhibit, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yumil's been doing a great job handling things on that end.」

name: Synn
message: 「What about Sacchin?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha. It's not that she isn't trying hard, I guess, but... read between the lines.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see.」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, I know! I'll order us some sweets from Demon World Mail-Order!」

name: Synn
message: 「Demon World sweets...」
Somehow, I ended up picturing something black and green, all slimy, twitching around here and there.
Prejudice isn't good, right?

name: Sally
message: 「They're super cute with black and green spots! When they're fresh, they twitch and spasm around, which is so fun! Plus they move on their own!」
Apparently, they're exactly what I imagined.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I appreciate the thought, really, but... y-you know, Sally-chan, you're super busy with Student Council work and your part-time job!」

name: Sally
message: 「You're such a good pal, Nanaka! No need to worry, I'm A-OK!! That stuff's a piece of cake before breakfast!」

name: Sally
message: 「Though before breakfast, my tummy is super-duper empty!」

name: Synn
message: 「When it comes to Sally-chan specifically, I don't think that's going to be okay at all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Um... There's something I wanted to ask you, Sally-chan.」

name: Sally
message: 「What is it, what is it? Ask away!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「About Bylous. You said he's the strongest in the Demon World, right?」

name: Sally
message: 「I did, yeah... What about it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then does that mean this Bylous guy is the king of the Demon World? The Demon Lord?」
Sorry, Nanaka. I'm the Demon Lord. Even though I'm the Demon Lord, I don't have a shred of the majesty or power befitting the ruler of the Demon World.

name: Sally
message: 「Sorry, no cigar. If he were really the Demon Lord, there's no way they'd go out of their way to call him a Demon General.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see. That makes sense.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So does that mean the Demon Lord is stronger than this Bylous guy?」

name: Sally
message: 「He's not famous, so he's probably weak, right? Even I only know that someone like that supposedly exists.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He's the Demon Lord, yet he's not famous?」
I'm glad I'm not famous.

name: Nanaka
message: 「From the way you make it sound, Sally-chan, he's not even the ruler of the Demon World.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah. That's right.」

name: Sally
message: 「I just thought of something! The Demon Lord is totally frail and decrepit!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!? Why!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are you surprised, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, I was just wondering what made you think that.」

name: Sally
message: 「If his existence is at least somewhat known, that means he was super famous way back in the day, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uh-huh.」

name: Sally
message: 「But nowadays he loses out to the Seven Demon Generals in name recognition, which means he has zero presence.」

name: Sally
message: 「In other words, he's already a frail old retiree who doesn't do anything at all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like living all alone in the corner of some Demon World public housing, relying solely on his Demon World pension?」

name: Sally
message: 「I don't know what 'public housing' or a 'pension' is, but yeah, like that.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Even the Demon Lord doesn't stand a chance against you guys.」

name: Sally
message: 「Maybe he even died of loneliness.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is he a rabbit...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「So they say.」
Treated like an animal, and killed off on top of that.
Still, having them think of me like this might actually be safer for me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn? What's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, no, it's just that I feel a little sorry for that Demon Lord.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I did say that earlier, but I really don't think they're dead, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sally, there aren't any bad rumors about the Demon Lord, right?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah. Nothing good or bad at all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then despite the name, they haven't really done anything all that bad. Doesn't seem like anyone holds a grudge against them either.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If they haven't been betraying people, they might have trustworthy companions or family.」

name: Synn
message: 「True...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In that case, they're definitely not alone. Probably.」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think they have a childhood friend too, like you are to me, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A childhood friend, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「If they do, I'm sure they're happy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you happy having me around too, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」
Nanaka smiled happily and murmured.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm sure they do.」
